scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run check:typecheck-scripts && pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./lib/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run typecheck:e2e
scripts.test: pnpm run check:test-scripts && pnpm run check:browser-requirements && pnpm run check:browser-output && pnpm run check:browser-commands && pnpm run check:command-requirements && pnpm run check:release-suites && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm -r --if-present run test
scripts.release:validate: pnpm run release:settings && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:e2e:moderation-recovery && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:e2e:launch-smoke && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:e2e:auth-layout && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:e2e:home-bar && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:e2e:hosted-home-bar && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:e2e:banned-room && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:e2e:moderation && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:e2e:moderation-timeout

checksOutsideFullRun.check:debugger: run as the expo-debugger workflow: it needs this workspace's Nix desktop libraries and downloads React Native's DevTools shell, neither of which `pnpm run test` has
checksOutsideFullRun.check:fonts: run as the chat-app-fonts workflow: it builds the published app and serves the output to fetch every font, a release-time run rather than a per-change one
